label: heart-s5
summary: The model is mostly additive on the logit scale: a direct linear leaf carries most of the ranking (training AUC 0.942, falling to 0.766 without it), led by the number of vessels on fluoroscopy (1.51 per sd), female sex (-1.08) and an upsloping ST segment (-0.90). The nonlinear side is an exercise-ischaemia hinge on ST depression, switched on earlier by a reversible thallium defect (on for 117 of 242 training patients, outcome rate 65.8%), feeding a gate that also rises when resting blood pressure is low, so for patients with ST depression the whole-model blood-pressure slope is flatter. The gate is read out by its own edge, by a second hinge for large gate values, and by an age hinge that adds a little risk for older patients while the gate is off. A relay chain on the fixed-defect level is described, not explained: switching it off changes mean risk by -1.3e-05.

tool_bugs: None blocking. Notes: (1) get_formula returns no provenance id, so formula evidence was attached as analytical_formula payloads. (2) add_evidence has no allow_numbers, so probe settings (e.g. an oldpeak of 2 mm) in evidence narratives were written in words. (3) A typed formula with underscored variable names (restecg_normal) was not recognised as a formula span and its coefficients were refused as bare numbers; plain names (restecg0) worked. (4) A composition cannot use another leaf's exit as an entry unless it lists that leaf as a child, so node 290, 1834 and 1987 sit as own nodes of the two compositions rather than in leaves.
